comment.body:
Thanks for including the `UWPApplication.Launch` stack trace. Because the report is from PowerToys 0.96.0.0 and names no application or trigger, we cannot tell whether this is an old issue already covered by the related UWP launch reports or a current regression.

Please provide:

1. Update to the latest stable PowerToys release and reply with the exact version; confirm whether the exception still occurs.
2. Name the packaged application and give short steps including the PowerToys Run query, expected result, and actual result.
3. If it still fails, reproduce it on the current build and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward.

This will determine whether the old stack trace represents active work or an already-handled version-specific failure.
